contexts.text: Thus... the common unity (conspires) to what is unanimous of individuals.
The form of the speech is according to the... unanimity of the Society.
Whatever destroys unanimity (there) is contrary to the order of Heaven, and therefore conspires to the destruction of the whole.
The more there come into Heaven, the more blessed it is for those there, because the consequent unanimity is stronger.
Every Society is an image of the whole; for that which is unanimous is composed of so many images of itself.
If Heaven were distinct according to the truths of faith there would be no Heaven, for there would be nothing of unanimity.
There are gyres... for in the other life there must be concord and unanimity of all...
They knew that by... a hill (Parnassus) is signified unanimity; and, in the spiritual sense, charity.
Under a different appearance, but still like and unanimous, like the soul and body.
For in the Heavens... there is a unanimous looking of all to one end, which is the common good.
The unanimity and concord of a number... produce perfection...
(Thus) the New Heaven is entirely unanimous; for he who lives a life of faith and charity loves another as himself... (and thus) there comes forth a unanimity...
This... merely gives an idea of the unanimity of the three Gods. BE 34. Ath 108.
(The English bishops) spoke together about unanimity and concord.
An influx from the Lord into Heaven, and thus a unanimity of the Angels, that... Signified, Explained.

There would (then) be a number of unanimous Gods, and not one God; for unanimity, which is the consensus of a number, and at the same time of each from himself and by himself, does not agree with the unity of God...
Thus wives lead a life with their husbands unanimous, and successively more unanimous.
The myriads of Angels are ordinated into one form, in which there is full unanimity and concord.
The union is reciprocal... thus is effected what is homogeneous, sympathetic, unanimous, and concordant in every particular.

Love is fundamental... as may be evident from this, that there must be such a harmony and unanimity, and derivative universal consociation, that the universal Heaven and World of Spirits, that is, the universal human race from the first creation, must form a one. Explained.
Thus (the English) think alike, and affirm unanimously.
Thereby all in that city (London) are kept in... unanimity and society.
Unanimity that the Word is Divine truth... Signified, Explained.
Unanimously. Signified, Explained.
The unanimity of the universal Heaven. Signified, Explained.
